plan: A fighter who jumps from target to target with her blades and becomes very strong once stacked.
aSurveiller: Her E (Flawless Duet). If you're caught between her two blades you are stunned and marked: she can then chain her dashes onto you.
contrer: Get out of the path between her two blades (E): otherwise you are stunned.
Don't let her reach 4 passive stacks: she becomes much stronger.
Push your minion wave: without low-health minions she can't bounce with her Q.
forces: Very mobile by bouncing off minions.
Strong in duels with her stacks.

sorts.P: Gains attack speed when hitting with her spells.
sorts.Q: Dash that resets if the target is marked or dies.
sorts.W: Charges an attack while reducing damage taken.
sorts.E: Two blades: those caught between them are stunned.
sorts.R: Wall of blades that damages and slows.

momentFort: Strong in the early game, very dangerous from level 6.
